objective: Count all minimal guard obstructions in the strict encoded implication family and decide a supplied activation vector.
status: Proved: A linear-size ternary family has exactly 2^r minimally constrained guard supports, all sharing 24 switches. A guard-only CNF needs exactly 2^r clauses. Deciding one guard vector takes exactly 24r+24 deterministic worst-case bit probes and logarithmic bounded-fan-in parallel depth.
title: Exponentially many overlapping obstructions with a linear decision procedure
